title: NVIDIA Announces New Planned Investments in Korean Startups at the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum

claims.claim: Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT and NVIDIA hosted the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum at COEX.

evidence.quote: Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT and NVIDIA hosted the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum at COEX.

claims.claim: Ryu Je-myung, vice minister of science and ICT, joined NVIDIA leaders to meet with over 20 Korean startups.

evidence.quote: Ryu Je-myung, vice minister of science and ICT, joined NVIDIA leaders to meet with over 20 Korean startups across foundation models, physical AI, AI infrastructure and AI semiconductors.

claims.claim: NVIDIA announced an investment in Korean startup Point2.

evidence.quote: NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2, with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies, RLWRLD and Upstage.

claims.claim: NVIDIA has additional investments planned in Motif Technologies, RLWRLD and Upstage.

evidence.quote: NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2, with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies, RLWRLD and Upstage.

claims.claim: Point2 Technology is an AI interconnect company that builds scalable, radio frequency-based interconnects.

evidence.quote: Point2 Technology, an AI interconnect company, builds scalable, radio frequency-based interconnects that move data between chips and racks in AI factories
Point2 Technology, an AI interconnect company, builds scalable, radio frequency-based interconnects that move data between chips and racks in AI factories...

claims.claim: Motif Technologies is a Seoul-based AI lab that developed Motif-3, a large language model released with open weights.

evidence.quote: Motif Technologies, a Seoul-based AI lab, develops foundation models for building AI agents that carry out complex tasks, including Motif-3, a large language model released with open weights.

claims.claim: RLWRLD is a physical AI startup based in San Francisco, Seoul and Tokyo.

evidence.quote: RLWRLD, a physical AI startup based in San Francisco, Seoul and Tokyo, develops robotics foundation models
RLWRLD, a physical AI startup based in San Francisco, Seoul and Tokyo, develops robotics foundation models...

claims.claim: More than 1,000 Korea-based members are part of NVIDIA Inception.

evidence.quote: including more than 1,000 Korea-based members of NVIDIA Inception

The planned investments build on NVIDIA’s work with Korea’s startup and venture community, including more than 1,000 Korea-based members of NVIDIA Inception, a program that helps startups grow with access to preferred pricing, technical expertise and opportunities for investor introductions.
